SRC-097:R001.text: SRC-097.md: '# User request / priority: P1 / verify: the requested change is present and demonstrated against the user own description of it / ## Request / T-249 close hydration/reconciliation hole: characterData-only audit turn recovery before READY' -> T-250

SRC-097:R002.text: Before an audit turn is READY, a hydration that changes only characterData (no new node, no click, no Resume) must still re-arm reconcileEnabledIdleAuditRuntime so an enabled+idle+generating runtime adopts wait-<wave> for a Core and for a non-Core wave alike.

SRC-097:R003.text: The recovery window must be BOUNDED (AUTO_HYDRATION_RECOVERY_WINDOW_MS, 120s) and must not become a second state machine: it opens only while enabled+idle+generating+no-lineage, collapses to the cheap childList-only 'turns' observer on generation end / adoption / auth / cap, ordinary generation rides it harmlessly (BUSY, never adopted), and reconcileEnabledIdleAuditRuntime() / resumeRuntimeFromAuditTurn() remain the sole runtime-adoption authority.
